name: ZDF — Spezifikation für filebasierte Anlieferungen (HD, profile ZDF-S01)

governance.spec_version: ZDF-Spezifikation filebasierte Anlieferungen v3.0 (06.10.2023); profile ZDF-S01
governance.source: ZDF-Spezifikation für filebasierte Anlieferungen v3.0 (2023); baseline: Technische Produktionsrichtlinien für ARD, ZDF und ORF (1. Auflage, Nov 2025)
governance.notes: ZDF (Zweites Deutsches Fernsehen). Current file-delivery main profile ZDF-S01 is AVC-Intra 100 / 10-bit (NOT the legacy XDCAM HD422 HDF01a 8-bit — that is retired for ZDF). Video: MXF OP1a (Single Item Single Package), AVC-Intra Class 100 (H.264 High 4:2:2 Intra, RP 2027), 1920x1080 @ 25 (1080p/25 or 1080i/25), 4:2:2, 10-bit, BT.709, limited range (EBU R103 v3.0). Audio: PCM 24-bit/48 kHz, discrete mono tracks (CHCOUNT=1, even count 2-16); assignment 1/2 Send L/R, 3/4 2nd language, 5/6 Audio Description, 7/8 Dolby E, 9-14 5.1 (L R C LFE Ls Rs); EBU R128 -23 LUFS +/-0.5 LU, LRA <=20, true peak -1 dBTP; alignment level -18 dBFS. TC start 10:00:00:00, NO technical leader/bars. Subtitles EBU STL sidecar (types hoh/omu/ls). Metadata Medienbegleitkarte v2.0. File naming Produktionsnummer(8)_SF-n_Titel.mxf (SF=Sendematerial, CF=Cleanfeed). HDR variant: XAVC HD Intra 100, 1080p/50, HLG BT.2100. PSE not specified. Language de. Shares the joint ARD/ZDF/ORF signal/loudness baseline but the file-delivery layer (codec, TC, naming, portal) is ZDF-specific.

codec.notes: AVC-Intra Class 100 (H.264 High 4:2:2 Intra, SMPTE RP 2027 Constrained), ~100 Mbit/s, 10-bit. Profile ZDF-S01.

container.notes: MXF OP1a per SMPTE 377, Single Item Single Package.

color.notes: ITU-R BT.709-6 (SDR HD). HDR variant uses HLG / BT.2100 / BT.2020.

codec.notes: Uncompressed PCM, discrete mono (CHCOUNT=1, little-endian); Dolby E for multichannel by arrangement.

track_count.notes: Discrete mono tracks, EVEN count only (2-16). Assignment: 1 Send-L, 2 Send-R, 3/4 2nd language, 5/6 Audio Description, 7/8 Dolby E, 9-14 5.1 (L R C LFE Ls Rs), 15/16 by agreement. Production/M&E on the Cleanfeed file.

layout.notes: Send L/R on 1/2; Audio Description on 5/6; 5.1 on 9-14.

loudness.notes: EBU R128 v5.0 / ITU-R BS.1770-5. -23.0 LUFS +/-0.5 LU, LRA <=20 LU, true peak -1 dBTP. Alignment level (Bezugspegel) -18 dBFS; permitted max -9 dBFS (9 dB headroom).

subtitles.notes: EBU STL (.stl) sidecar, frame rate matching video, 25 fps TC grid. Types: hoh (hard-of-hearing), omu (original+subs), ls (easy language); ISO 639-2/T language codes. Audio description delivered as audio tracks 5-6, not a text service.

metadata.notes: Medienbegleitkarte (MBK) v2.0 (Excel), named identically to the media file, or ZDF upload web form. File naming Produktionsnummer(8 digits)_SF-n_Titel.mxf (SF=Sendematerial, CF=Cleanfeed, NTH=neutral title bg; _MT for Mediathek). Only [0-9 a-z A-Z - _]; no umlauts/spaces.

timeline.notes: Continuous 25 fps TC grid, no gaps; first frame = programme start = 10:00:00:00. No technical leader, precharge, bars or slate ('ohne techn. Vorspann').

luminance.tolerance_note: EBU R103 v3.0, 10-bit (nominal black 64 / white 940). RGB and derived Y between -5% and +105% (-35..735 mV); gamut error if out-of-gamut >1% of picture area; TRS values (10-bit 0-3 and 1020-1023) forbidden.
